profile.name: Sonu Choudhary
profile.title: VFX Associate & Visual Creative
profile.tagline: Transforming bold concepts into viral visuals, high-conversion 3D web experiences, cinematic stories, 2D & 3D Animation.
profile.bio: I’m a VFX Associate and Visual Creative passionate about transforming ideas into engaging visual experiences. My work spans VFX compositing, cinematic video editing, wedding films, wedding album designing, motion graphics, and graphic design. I focus on creating visually polished content with strong storytelling, attention to detail, and a cinematic aesthetic. From crafting memorable wedding moments and designing elegant albums to producing dynamic graphics and visual effects, I bring creativity and technical precision to every project. Over 5+ years of experience helping brands, creators, and studios stand out through bespoke digital design and interactive storytelling.
